Class Instances.CallableInstances

java.lang.Object
forj.Instances.CallableInstances
All Implemented Interfaces:
Applicative<Callable>, ApplicativeError<Callable, Throwable>, Async<Callable>, Bracket<Callable, Throwable>, Effect<Callable>, Functor<Callable>, Monad<Callable>, MonadError<Callable, Throwable>, Sync<Callable>
Enclosing class:
Instances
public static final class Instances.CallableInstances extends Object implements Effect<Callable>
Callable is a lazy effect that can be run (Effect), but not Concurrent and not FunctorFilter (a guard has nothing to drop). Its async blocks the calling thread until the callback fires, which is cheap on a virtual thread.
